_source: Built 2026-11-20 from the names in the old results tables. Short names, initials and 'Last First' order are mapped to one person. Entries in 'guesses' are educated guesses that the club should confirm.

guesses.Ivan: Only in Koningschap 2022. Ivan Merckx has no results after 2021 and Yvan Van Migerode is also written 'Ivan V.M.' in 2022.
guesses.Jefken: Jef is short for Jozef, and 'Jefken B.' never fishes in the same match as Jozef Bassleer.
guesses.Brackie: The 2022 'GP De Wuffel - Braeckeleer' is called 'GP Brackie & Evert' in the 2024 calendar, so Brackie is Rudy De Braeckeleer.
